issue_records.body_excerpt:
Tried to debug https://github.com/jump-dev/ParametricOptInterface.jl/issues/201
Ran into https://github.com/jump-dev/Ipopt.jl/pull/528

Found these.

With this
```Julia
julia> import MathOptInterface as MOI

julia> import ParametricOptInterface as POI

julia> import SCS

julia> begin
           inner = POI.Optimizer(SCS.Optimizer)
           model = MOI.Bridges.full_bridge_optimizer(inner, Float64)
           p, _ = MOI.add_constrained_variable(model, MOI.Parameter(1.0))
           MOI.Bridges.print_active_bridges(model)
       end

 * Supported variable: MOI.Parameter{Float64}
```

cross_repository_issue_records.title: POI failing with Clarabel
cross_repository_issue_records.body_excerpt:
Observed in this environment:

Julia=1.10.1
POI=0.14.2
MOI=1.49.0
SCS=2.6.1

```julia
import MathOptInterface as MOI
import ParametricOptInterface as POI
using SCS

inner = MOI.instantiate(SCS.Optimizer; with_bridge_type = Float64, with_cache_type = Float64)
model = POI.Optimizer(inner)
MOI.set(model, MOI.Silent(), true)

x = MOI.add_variable(model)
p, _ = MOI.add_constrained_variable(model, MOI.Parameter(1.0))

f = MOI.ScalarAffineFunction(
    [MOI.ScalarAffineTerm(1.0, x), MOI.ScalarAffineTerm(-1.0, p)],
    0.0,
)
MOI.add_constraint(model, f, MOI.EqualTo(0.0))

MOI.set(model, MOI.ObjectiveSense(), MOI.MIN_SENSE)
MOI.set(
    model,
    MOI.ObjectiveFunction{MOI.ScalarAffineFunction{Float64}}(),
    MOI.ScalarAffineFunction([MOI.ScalarAffineTerm(1.0, x)], 0.0),
)

println("first optimize")
MOI.optimize!(model)
println("x=", MOI.get(model, MOI.VariablePrimal(), x), " p=", MOI.get(model, POI.ParameterValue(), p))

MOI.set(model, POI.ParameterValue(), p, 2.0)
println("second optimize")
MOI.optimize!(model)  # Fails here with ModifyConstraintNotAllowed + modify_constants(::SCS._SetConstants, ...)

```
